_meta.built: 2026-10-20 wiring lane: programmatic join of animations/manifest.json + tools/NoMercy-FileTableDB.txt labels + re-docs/docs/moves/move-database.md power tables
_meta.canon_conversion: Move IDs renamed NM-### -> MK-#### (mat-kings universe per RENAME-MAP.md). Move display names are the teardown DB technique names, retained pending owner proprietary names (see teardown/wwf-no-mercy/CANON-CONVERSION.md).
_meta.federation_rule: Every entry carries a Tekken-style input (tekken_input) and MOVE-SLOTS.json slot eligibility: wrestling moves enter the library wired to Tekken inputs/structure, per owner law.
_meta.isolation: Library data only. No per-character file is touched; fighters consume entries through their own moveset JSON (pantera-moveset.json pattern), so one character’s assignments can never alter another’s.
